title: FUND-6: Verify unverified programs at the source (Sloan, Ford/Mellon, NSF POSE, Apache, Open Source Collective, cloud OSS credits)
body:

**Status:** closed
**Default in effect:** Default: tracked as unverified, not used in any pitch.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 272.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
